feature1.prompt: Permutation constructor fails with non-disjoint cycles. Calling Permutation([[0,1],[0,1]]) raises a ValueError instead of constructing the identity permutation. I don't see a reason why non-disjoint cycles should be forbidden.

The fix involves revising the block that checks for duplicates and adjusting the conditions accordingly.
